🎬 Summerland (2020)

Summerland follows Alice Lamb, a fiercely independent and reclusive writer living alone in a peaceful English coastal village during World War II. Preferring solitude and her research into folklore and mythology, Alice has little interest in forming relationships with the people around her, especially children. However, her carefully protected world changes when she is unexpectedly asked to care for Frank, a young boy evacuated from London to escape the dangers of German bombing raids. Initially frustrated by the responsibility, Alice struggles to adjust to having someone else in her home, while Frank attempts to understand her unusual personality and distant behavior. As the two gradually develop an unexpected friendship, Frank’s curiosity and kindness begin breaking down the emotional barriers Alice has built around herself. Their growing connection also brings back memories of Alice’s past relationship with Vera, a woman whose love profoundly shaped her life. Through flashbacks, the film reveals the heartbreak, difficult choices, and personal sacrifices that led Alice to withdraw from the world. As the war continues and uncertainty surrounds Frank’s family, Alice begins discovering that love and companionship can bring healing even after years of loneliness. Combining beautiful English countryside scenery, heartfelt performances, emotional storytelling, and touching moments of humor, Summerland explores love, loss, acceptance, family, forgiveness, and the extraordinary power of second chances.

🎭 Genre: Drama • Romance • War

⭐ IMDb: 7.0/10

⏱️ Runtime: 1h 39m • PG

🎥 Director: Jessica Swale

source_details.synopsis: Summerland is a 2020 British drama film written and directed by Jessica Swale, starring Gemma Arterton, Gugu Mbatha-Raw, Lucas Bond, Dixie Egerickx, Siân Phillips, Penelope Wilton and Tom Courtenay. Arterton plays a reclusive writer forced to take in a young boy entrusted to her care during the Battle of Britain in 1940, and, later, during the early days of the London Blitz. It was released in the United Kingdom on 31 July 2020 by Lionsgate.
